title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-29 07:22:49 最新章节：第1162章 吃剑老魔
content_zh:
道历一万两千零六十年，玄州大赵青云宗
山门地下密室中正举行着一场神秘仪式
布满凹槽的阵法中心躺着个须发皆白的老者
鲜红的血液正从他四肢流出不断沿着纹路散去
他双眼微眯盯着几米开外操纵阵法的黑衣蒙面人嘴角朝下不屑说道：“少宗主亏你平时自诩正人君子，没想到是个连自己人都不放过的奸诈小人”
听到杨威这话蒙面人也不恼，取下面罩露出一张正气凌然的国字脸，轻笑着道：“杨长老宗门栽培你这么久，现在也该你回馈的时候了，放心你的内丹将助我成就元婴大道！
我宗不会忘记你的奉献”
“放你娘的狗屁，说的大义凛然不过是恩将仇报，兔死狗烹罢了，今日之仇，老夫来世必报！
老者的声音铿锵有力，眼神中没有丝毫胆怯
似乎被他的话语刺痛，操纵阵法的男子没再说话，只将阵法运转加快
血红光芒于阵法上闪耀，照在男人脸上显得格外阴翳
失血过多的杨威直感到头晕目眩，过往如同走马灯般在脑中闪现
“中啦！
我中啦哈哈哈！
一本！
牛逼！
呃……
正吃着土家香酱饼看着手机的杨威忽的跳起，随后便因为食物哽咽而亡
随后便穿越到了这方世界，算起来在此界也已活了七百五十六年
并非此界人的寿命奇长而是他有着死而复生的异能，不管怎么死的总能立即重生在新的肉体上

第一世刚来大赵便被抓了壮丁，数根长矛穿肚死于残酷的世俗战争
第二世运气不错成了个秀才，日日捧着书卷苦读，妄图通过努力考取功名，可惜家道寒酸，学习天赋又一般，不到四十岁便感染风寒不幸去世
第三世有了一定经验加之出生不错，励精图治终于科举上岸，做了个有点权利的小县令，娶了县里大户女儿，子孙满堂，家庭和睦，纵享人世繁华
结果最后因为顶头上司贪污受贿他被拿去顶罪，还被人检举与老丈人家官商勾结，随后便吃了封建王朝至尊套餐“满门抄斩”
也是这一世官场里的摸爬滚打让他知晓了这个世界有着超凡力量的存在
就像他过往看过的小说影视一样，这是个可以修行追求长生大道的世界
于是他的人生格言便成了“万般皆下品，唯有修仙高”
第四世果断放弃科考转而求仙问道，终于寻到一个小宗门投靠
说是修行其实是被当免费劳动力打杂了几年，中间又辗转了几个小宗，身死于求道的路上
第五世成功入道一路修行至炼气五重，天赋一般没有资源没有背景便是到了极限
第六世开始寻找赚取资源的路子，从而接触修仙百艺，最终决定死磕有助于修行的炼丹一道
所幸遇到良师拜入其门下，通过大半辈子努力成为了一阶炼丹师
通过炼丹赚取灵石后，修为也随之突破筑基，并开始为下一世而准备资源
content_en:
In the 12,060th year of the Taoist calendar, the Qingyun Sect of Xuanzhou Great Zhao
A mysterious ceremony is being held in the underground secret room of Shanmen
In the center of the grooved formation lies an old man with white hair and beard.
Bright red blood is flowing out of his limbs and spreading along the lines.
He narrowed his eyes slightly and stared at the masked man in black who was manipulating the formation a few meters away, and said with disdain, "Young Master, you usually think of yourself as a gentleman, but you didn't expect that you are a treacherous villain who doesn't even spare your own people."
Hearing Yang Wei's words, the masked man was not upset. He took off his mask and revealed a righteous face with Chinese characters. He chuckled and said: "Elder Yang's sect has cultivated you for so long, and now it's time for you to give back. Don't worry, your inner elixir will help me achieve the Nascent Soul Path!
Our sect will never forget your dedication.”
"Fuck your mother, what you say about righteousness is nothing more than repaying a favor with a grudge, a rabbit will die and a dog will be cooked. Today's revenge will be avenged by me in the next life!
The old man's voice was sonorous and powerful, and there was no fear in his eyes.
As if being stung by his words, the man controlling the formation said nothing more, and only accelerated the operation of the formation.
Blood-red light shines on the formation, making the man's face look particularly gloomy.
Yang Wei, who had lost too much blood, felt dizzy, and the past flashed through his mind like a revolving lantern.
"Hit!
I won hahaha!
One copy!
Awesome!
Uh...
Yang Wei, who was eating Tujia fragrant sauce pancakes and looking at his mobile phone, suddenly jumped up and then choked to death due to food.
Then he traveled to this world, and he has lived in this world for 756 years.
It's not that people in this world have unusually long lifespans, but that they have the ability to resurrect from the dead. No matter how they die, they can always be reborn in a new body immediately.
When the first generation came to Zhao, he was captured as a young man. Several spears were pierced through his belly and he died in a cruel secular war.
In the second life, he was lucky enough to become a scholar. He studied hard every day with books in hand, hoping to gain fame through hard work. Unfortunately, his family was poor and his academic talent was average. He contracted cold and died when he was less than forty years old.
In the third life, he had some experience and a good birth. He worked hard and finally passed the imperial examination. He became a small county magistrate with some power. He married the daughter of a wealthy family in the county. He had many children and grandchildren, a harmonious family and enjoyed the prosperity of the world.
In the end, he was accused of corruption and bribery by his immediate superior, and was also accused of colluding with his father-in-law's family, officials and businessmen. Afterwards, he was eaten the "Supreme Course of the Feudal Dynasty" and "Beheaded"
It was also his struggles in officialdom in this life that made him aware of the existence of extraordinary power in this world.
Just like the novels and movies he has watched in the past, this is a world where one can practice and pursue the path to immortality.
So his life motto became "Everything is inferior, only cultivating immortals is high."
The fourth generation decisively gave up the scientific examination and turned to seek immortality, and finally found a small sect to seek refuge with.
It was said that he was cultivating, but in fact, he worked as a free labor force for several years, and moved around a few small sects. He died on the way to seek the Tao.
In the fifth life, he successfully entered Taoism and practiced all the way to the fifth level of Qi refining. Generally, his talent has reached his limit without resources or background.
The sixth life began to look for ways to earn resources, and thus came into contact with the various arts of cultivating immortals. Finally, he decided to devote himself to alchemy, which is helpful for spiritual cultivation.
Fortunately, I met a good teacher and became his disciple. After working hard for most of my life, I became a first-level alchemist.
After earning spiritual stones through alchemy, your cultivation level will also break through the foundation building, and you will begin to prepare resources for the next life.
